fee_notes: Standard minimum fee is $45,000 for territory up to 100,000 population. Rural franchise special pricing available at 50% of minimum ($22,500) for territories 40,000-65,000 population. Additional territory charged at $450 per 1,000 population. Discounts available: VetFran, HVAC license (5%), multi-territory, roll-in (varies). Average fee paid in 2025 was $68,685 (range $39,325–$115,379 including territory variations and discounts).
raw_excerpt: The initial franchisee fee you must pay to us is $45,000 (the "Minimum Initial Franchise Fee"), which is a fee for a territory of up to 100,000 in population. A "rural franchise" is a franchise for a territory (i) with a population size of at least 40,000 and not more than 65,000; (ii) that does not include a city of more than 30,000 in population; and (iii) that is not included within a standard metropolitan statistical area. The lowest initial franchise fee payable for a rural franchise will be 50% of our Minimum Initial Franchise Fee unless the application of the VetFran discount results in a lower fee.
